description: Implementation of QR Code segments, including creation methods for numeric, alphanumeric, byte, and ECI segments, as well as segment property accessors and internal logic for total bits calculation.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of data in a QR code, with methods for creation, property access, and internal calculations.

classes.name: QrSegment::Mode
classes.description: Encapsulates the mode of a QR segment, including mode bits and character count bits for different versions.

methods.name: QrSegment::makeBytes
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from raw byte data.

methods.name: QrSegment::makeNumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from a numeric string.

methods.name: QrSegment::makeAlphanumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from an alphanumeric string.

methods.name: QrSegment::makeSegments
methods.description: Automatically selects the most efficient segment encoding for the input text.

methods.name: QrSegment::makeEci
methods.description: Creates an ECI segment with a specified assignment value.

methods.name: QrSegment::getTotalBits
methods.description: Calculates total bits needed for a list of segments at a specific QR code version.

methods.name: QrSegment::isAlphanumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string can be encoded in alphanumeric mode.

methods.name: QrSegment::isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only numeric characters.

methods.name: QrSegment::getMode
methods.description: Returns the mode of the segment.

methods.name: QrSegment::getNumChars
methods.description: Returns the number of characters in the segment.

methods.name: QrSegment::getData
methods.description: Returns the data bits of the segment.
